- Requirement: "Extend prompts/mode-plan.txt with the three-layer reuse-audit rule and the new Reuse-audit: output field placed after Scope-mode:."
  Expected change site: prompts/mode-plan.txt (Output contract numbered list, Rules section)
  Evidence of absence: The diff correctly adds the Reuse-audit: output field as item 9 in the numbered list (between Scope-mode at 8 and Scope-mode justification at 10), and adds the Layer 1/2/3 bullet list under Rules. However, items 8 and 10 in the numbered list both use the label "Scope-mode requirement gate" — the original single "Scope-mode requirement gate" (old item 9) described TWO responsibilities (emitting the Scope-mode: line AND the justification block). After the split, item 8 now describes only the Scope-mode: line ("Scope-mode requirement gate") and item 10 describes only the justification block ("Scope-mode requirement gate"). Both share the same label text, making them indistinguishable in the spec. Item 8 should ideally be labeled to reflect it only covers the Scope-mode: line (e.g. "Scope-mode line output") and item 10 covers the "Scope-mode requirement gate" (the justification). This is not a runtime defect since the model reads the prose, but it creates an internally ambiguous spec where items 8 and 10 share a label yet describe different deliverables.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
